title: C CCP-15: busy-percent, density estimator, interference score missing
description: NOT-IMPLEMENTED in C/Zephyr. Req 2a.10.3: BusyPercent MUST be TX-time based occupancy, not RSSI-only; EstimateDensity(NeighborCount, LossPermille, RssiEmaDbm): D=NeighborCount, +2 if LossPermille>DENSITY_PER_BONUS_PERMILLE(100), +1 if RssiEmaDbm<DENSITY_RSSI_BONUS_DBM(-90), MIN(255); MUST use exactly these proposed defaults. Req 2a.10.4: InterferenceScoreTenths=BusyPercent*10+PacketErrorPermille, MUST reject busy>100/PER>1000, MUST match ccp15.json score_tenths + ccp-interference.json. Evidence: C rf_health.c has EMA + loss permille (:94-99) and saturating counters, but density is an externally supplied input (lichen_rf_health_record_density rf_health.c:70-73, lichen_lora_l2_set_density); no busy-percent sampler, no interference score (LICHEN_INTERFERENCE_ESCAPE_TENTHS 1000U defined gradient.h:262 but unused). Python reference: ccp.py:118-188,220-228,442-464; Rust reference: rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:100-139,301-367. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.c (+ rf_health.h constants DENSITY_PER_BONUS_PERMILLE/DENSITY_RSSI_BONUS_DBM) + test under lichen/tests/rf_health consuming ccp-interference.json (no C consumer today).
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.29 (CCP-15 metrics layer absent: TX-time BusyPercent, RF metrics window, density estimation, score logging, consolidated MitigateInterference, spec 02a 2a.10.3-2a.10.5); evidence consolidated in docs/spec-coverage/02a-coordinated-capacity.md
